description: Join as an Activist Builder and help communities coordinate and become more self-sufficient.

sections.heading: Activist Builder
sections.intro:
Activist Builders are the technical partners of Logos Circles. They help communities use tools, tackle technical challenges, and turn recurring problems into practical solutions, locally or remotely across several Circles.

The programme includes core training on Logos, community needs, product development, and the technology stack, plus opportunities to collaborate with fellow builders and contribute to projects.

Tell us about your background, skills, and the work you'd like to contribute to. Not every field is required, but sharing more helps us understand where your skills could be useful.

Want to explore the technology first? [Discover the Logos stack](/get-started).

We'll review your application and get back to you.
sections.privacy: We respect your privacy. By clicking 'Submit', you consent to our processing of your personal data as described above and in our Privacy Policy .
